privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey title must be 'Streaming Services Consumer Evaluation Q4 2024'. The Multiple Choice question (Type M) must have 7 sub-questions: Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, HBO Max, Hulu, Apple TV+, and Peacock. Both Array questions (Type F) must have the 'array_filter' attribute set to the question code of the Multiple Choice question. The survey must be set to anonymous and activated.
